sections.Profile:
The "Hot Diggity" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on May 28, 1956, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1956
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Good Times, Wood Rail, Dancing, Original Theme, Music
